$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Product photo studio
blocks.for: Listing photographs of a model as PNGs: a lit studio scene (backdrop, light rig, filament finishes, a contact shadow) averaged over many jittered passes for smooth edges and a soft shadow, up to 6000 px, queued, with progress and a stop; and the plan that turns shots times colourways into named files.

blocks.name: Studio preview
blocks.for: The photo studio's scene live in a page element at one pass, orbited by hand: the same scene a still renders, so what it shows is what comes out. Keeps the framing per view, reads the camera back as a shot, pauses while a batch renders.

blocks.name: Studio picture tile
blocks.for: A small square studio still for a picture tile: a backdrop, light rig, finish or shot shown on the loaded model, or on a plain sphere when there is none.

blocks.name: Coloured model reader
blocks.for: An STL, OBJ or 3MF loaded for the photo studio, y-up: a 3MF keeps the colours it was sliced, painted or declared in, as regions that can each be recoloured (first plate only); an STL or OBJ is one region.

blocks.name: Studio looks
blocks.for: What a product photograph is made of, as data: backdrops (white, washes, dark, transparent, custom), light rigs, seven filament finishes, a shelf of filament colours, preset camera shots, and quarter turns to stand a model up.

blocks.name: Colourways
blocks.for: Named sets of region colours a batch multiplies by: As printed keeps the file's own colours, and an override gives one region a colour and a finish.
